description: Transfer and boot size of what the viewer ships, measured by scripts/perf-ratchet/measure-bundle.mjs from the build job's artifacts: brotli (quality 11, node zlib) of the engine WASM, and raw bytes of the viewer's main entry chunk and of every JS file dist/index.html loads eagerly (eager bytes are the blocking ceiling, #7002). Viewer JS is gated raw because brotli-11 of it jumps by ~0.5% on a same-length timestamp change; its brotli sizes are reported, not gated (#7007). Raising a ceiling is a human PR with a justification (docs/guide/performance.md, 'Perf ratchet ceilings'); lowering is the daily perf-ratchet-lower.yml job (Refs #6955).

entries.description: raw size of the single <script type="module" src> chunk of apps/viewer/dist/index.html
summed raw size of every JS file dist/index.html loads eagerly: the module <script src> plus <link rel=modulepreload>
